reader.requirement: At COBOL-85, in a report whose RD has no PAGE clause, every NEXT GROUP clause in every report group must be the relative form (NEXT GROUP PLUS integer-2): the absolute form (integer-1) and NEXT PAGE must be refused, and the relative form accepted.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 adds the 1985-only SR1 screen (NEXT GROUP needs a LINE NUMBER clause); the SR3 test (!model.Paged with an absolute or NEXT PAGE form) is unconditional
Constructs.ReportPageForms2002 refuses at 85 a PAGE clause without its page limit or with a width, so at 85 a written PAGE clause always sets model.Paged

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the SR3 screen is the same code at every edition; only the PAGE-clause forms that decide 'paged' differ (85 has no width-only PAGE clause)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f01_06 exercises only the accepted relative form in an unpaged report; the refusal of the absolute form and of NEXT PAGE without a PAGE clause is not exercised

probes.printed: COBOL2284 on RH1 NEXT GROUP IS 5 and on DE1 NEXT GROUP IS 9: 'the report is not divided into pages, so only the relative form of the NEXT GROUP clause may be specified' (plus COBOL2199 for the absolute LINE 1)
probes.expected: both absolute NEXT GROUP clauses refused (SR3)

probes.printed: COBOL2284 on DE1 and CF1 NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE (plus an unrelated COBOL0899: the probe's CF FINAL lacked CONTROL FINAL)
probes.expected: NEXT PAGE refused in an unpaged report (SR3)
absolute NEXT GROUP and NEXT PAGE accepted when PAGE is written

probes.printed: RH LC 00 / DE LC 03 / DE LC 07 / END LC 11; EXPECT: MATCH
probes.expected: relative NEXT GROUP accepted without a PAGE clause and applied

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR3  (3.16.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3

reader.notes: The rule is a pure refusal rule keyed on model.Paged, set only when the PAGE clause's integer-1 is written; at 85 integer-1 is mandatory (the width-only form is refused as a 2002 form), so 'PAGE clause omitted' and !Paged coincide. Diagnostics cite §2023:13.18.37.3 SR3 at --std 85, the same rule in substance.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.3.16 whole (SR1-SR5) and ReportSectionBinder.cs#BindNextGroupClauses (SR3 arms at lines 930 and 944, keyed on model.Paged set in BindReportDescriptionClauses only when the PAGE clause's integer-1 is written; at 85 integer-1 is mandatory). Probe refute-1985-212/src/ng_two_reports.cob (one FD, REPORTS ARE R1 R2; R1 paged with absolute NEXT GROUP 3 and 10; R2 unpaged with absolute NEXT GROUP on RH, CH (bare 'NEXT GROUP 6' without IS) and CF, relative PLUS 2 on DE) at --std 85: three COBOL2284 exactly on R2's RH2, CH2, CF2; R1 and R2's relative DE2 not flagged. The screen is per report and covers every group type the rule reaches (PH/RF NEXT GROUP is refused by SR5 first). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR3  (3.16.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3'.
